_meta.note: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 driven over stdio (copilot --acp --stdio). The initialize answer (protocolVersion 1, loadSession, sessionCapabilities close and list, mcpCapabilities http and sse), the session/new answer carrying the mode and allow_all selects and the modes block, and the session/set_config_option answers: allow_all off, a mode write to autopilot that turns allow_all on, allow_all off again, the mode back to agent, then a refused value and an unknown option id (both -32602). The /allow-all on prompt in between is answered by the harness itself, and its config_option_update reporting allow_all on arrives only after the next config write. Reductions: session and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the recording host's scratch paths replaced with /work/copilot-probe; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames dropped; authMethods' terminal-auth command normalized to copilot.

options.description: Default agent mode for conversational interactions

options.name: Plan

options.description: Autonomous mode that enables allow-all and runs until task completion without user interaction (experimental)

options.name: Off
options.description: Require approval for tool, path, and URL requests
